items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: Who was the cornet player in Robichaux's band? Kimball.

ctx.x: When John Robichaux's band? Who? In Robichaux's band, who was the cornet player?
Who was the cornet player in Robichaux's band? Kimball. Uh. Kimball! Yeah, Kimball, yeah. Kimball.
